description: This Java class `BaseWebContextSensitiveTest` serves as a base class for web-related tests within the OpenMRS project. It sets up test configurations for controller and web component testing by extending `BaseContextSensitiveTest`, adding specific Spring context configurations, and integrating web application context annotations. It is deprecated as of version 2.4 and has a migration path to a JUnit 5 counterpart.

classes.name: BaseWebContextSensitiveTest
classes.description: An abstract class for web context-sensitive testing in OpenMRS, extending the base context-sensitive test class and setting up web application context configurations.
